decision.explanation: Both 'Royal Order of the Seraphim' (from D1) and 'Righteous Among the Nations' (from D2) are explicitly stated in the source texts as awards received by Jeanne Maindron. The sources describe distinct honors from different entities (Swedish government and State of Israel/Yad Vashem) for similar acts of bravery. No contradictions exist regarding the existence of these awards; they represent complementary valid answers to the question asking which award(s) she received.
